artifactText: {"schemaVersion":1,"findings":[{"id":"sql-injection-invoice-customer","title":"SQL injection through customer query parameter","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 8-10, especially `customer = '${req.query.customer}'`","evidence":"The route interpolates untrusted `req.query.customer` directly into the SQL string passed to `db.query(sql)`. An attacker can alter the query structure with quote characters and SQL syntax.","repair":"Use a parameterized query supported by the database driver, such as `db.query('SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE customer = $1', [req.query.customer])`, and validate the parameter is a string of an expected length and format.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"path-traversal-download-name","title":"Arbitrary file access through download path traversal","severity":"high","location":"Lines 14-16, `path.join(DATA_ROOT, req.query.name)` followed by `res.sendFile(requested)`","evidence":"`req.query.name` is user-controlled and is joined directly into a filesystem path. Values containing traversal segments can resolve outside `/srv/app/downloads`, allowing requests for unintended server files.","repair":"Reject absolute paths and traversal segments, resolve the candidate path with `path.resolve(DATA_ROOT, name)`, and require it to remain within `DATA_ROOT + path.sep` before sending it. Prefer mapping validated file identifiers to server-side filenames rather than accepting paths.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"command-injection-diagnostics-host","title":"Command injection through diagnostics host","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 19-20, `exec(`ping -c 1 ${req.body.host}`)`","evidence":"The route embeds untrusted `req.body.host` into a shell command executed by `exec`. Shell metacharacters in the supplied host can append or substitute arbitrary commands.","repair":"Avoid shell execution. Use `execFile` or `spawn` with fixed arguments, for example `execFile('ping', ['-c', '1', validatedHost], callback)`, and strictly validate `validatedHost` as an IP address or approved hostname before invocation.","confidence":"high"}],"summary":"The source contains three high-impact injection risks: SQL injection in invoice lookup, path traversal in file download handling, and shell command injection in diagnostics."}
